annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to emissions from heavy duty vehicles (Euro VI) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on type-approval of motor vehicles and engines with respect to emissions from heavy duty vehicles (Euro VI) and on access to vehicle repair and maintenance information
annotation.summary_en: 2007 Commission proposal for an EU Regulation setting Euro VI emission limits for heavy-duty vehicles and engines, tightening particulate and NOx limits, requiring type-approval, and guaranteeing independent operators access to repair and maintenance information. It concerns conventional vehicle emissions, not AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Euro VI limits: about 66% cut in particulate mass and 80% cut in NOx for compression-ignition engines
Manufacturers must type-approve vehicles, engines and replacement pollution control devices
Defeat strategies prohibited; tampering with reagent systems penalised
Unrestricted standardised access to OBD and repair information for independent operators
Applies from 1 April 2013; older directives repealed from 1 October 2014
